title: Junior Web Application Security Engineer
summary: Entry-level role testing web applications and APIs, writing vulnerability reports, and supporting disclosure.
must_have: Hands-on web application testing experience (internship, lab or research counts)
Working knowledge of Burp Suite and Python
Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
responsibilities: Test web applications and APIs for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
Write vulnerability reports and track fixes
Support responsible disclosure with outside researchers
